The main takeaway from our work is that
these tumors can present with clinical features similar to those of chronic liver disease and that the diagnosis is often not suspected before orthotopic liver transplant or autopsy.
the presence of liver failure with portal hypertension in the absence of cirrhosis should prompt a search for a primary tumor.
